implementation: Independent wallet portfolios, pinned deterministic workers and per-conversation attachment
limits: The existing funded raw-key runner was not restarted; it retains its loaded runtime until a later user launch.
Privy was registered and viewed only; no actual Privy signature, provider mainnet acceptance or swap was tested.
New Privy notifications remain unconfigured until a destination is selected.
Native multi-wallet hook dispatch and a newly connected live Claude channel are fixture-tested, not demonstrated in a fresh user session.
Queue acceptance and acknowledgement do not prove mobile delivery.
Privy CLI 0.3.6 exposes one first-Ethereum session wallet and no per-request wallet selector; app profile isolation does not add concurrent independent Privy logins.
publishedRecord: Aggregate validation results only. Local wallet addresses, holdings, balances, process identifiers, conversation identifiers and state fingerprints are excluded.
